newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle slow $64.50-$65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle slow $64.50-$65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to $0.50 per cwt lower. Feedlots reporting limited inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 3,900 slaughter steers and 500 heifers; following the weekly movement of 97,000 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.50-65.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.50.
Confirmed - 4,400 Week Ago - 500 Year Ago - None
